First real-MySQL run of the tenant package: 40 failures. Two root causes, both in the test layer rather than the fix: (R4) tenantTestDDL did not declare system_dict_type / system_dict_item, so FIX-4's dictionary copy died with MySQL 1146; (R3) the session revocation test wrote `db.Exec(...)` without `.Error`, so the assertion was always false once a DSN existed. Both fixtures repaired and the package then passed (see the passing entries above).

Regression introduced by FIX-5 itself (R2): the new reverse namespace mutex matched the very role being renamed, so editing a platform role shadowed by a tenant key failed with `role.key.reserved`. Fixed by threading excludeRoleID through ensureRoleKeyAllowed; role package then passed (43.582s ok).

First FIX-5 attempt (R1): the scope condition was assembled as `"tenant_id "+column` with no `?` placeholder, so MySQL answered 1064 near 'AND deleted_at IS NULL'. Placeholder added; suite green afterwards.
